What We Do

For all types of businesses.

From market to kitchen, we deliver more than produce — we deliver reliability, flexibility and trust.

01 — Sourcing

Importing & Wholesale

Sourced directly from trusted farms and suppliers across the region, offering a wide variety of vegetables and fruits at competitive wholesale rates, with consistent quality and flexible volumes.

02 — Kitchen-Ready

Processing & Preparation

Customised washing, cutting and packing services that save you time and keep your kitchen efficient — every order prepared under strict food safety standards.

03 — Compliance

Labelling & Packaging

From retail-ready packs to bulk kitchen-use cartons — clear, compliant labels and portion-controlled packaging that improve traceability, organisation and shelf life.

04 — Logistics

Storage & Distribution

Cold-chain logistics and storage keep produce fresh from our warehouse to your doorstep, with islandwide delivery operating six days a week.

Our Story

Rooted in family. Growing since 2020.

Founded in honour of Yi Jie's late mother, whose surname 蔡 (Cai) lives on through our name, House of Cai represents more than just fresh vegetables. It is a living tribute to the woman whose care, resilience and traditions laid the foundation for everything we do today.

We began with a simple belief — that food is not just sustenance, but a form of love passed from one generation to the next. This belief grew into a mission: to supply fresh, quality produce with the warmth and reliability of a home-cooked meal.

From humble beginnings in family-run markets to becoming a trusted supplier across Singapore's vibrant culinary scene, House of Cai now partners with restaurants, cafes, bars, hotels and hawkers. But no matter how much we've grown, we never forget where we came from: a family kitchen filled with care, laughter, and the smell of freshly chopped vegetables.

Food Safety

We are certified.

ISO 22000:2024

We value the importance of food safety. By obtaining ISO 22000:2024 certification, we are committed to providing safe and high-quality produce to every restaurant, cafe, hotel and hawker we serve.
